name: Default
shortDescription: Decentralized social network server with the Rails web app, streaming API, Sidekiq workers, PostgreSQL and Redis.

alerts.message: HTTPS is required: Mastodon forces HTTPS in production, so the instance does not work on a plain HTTP domain.
LOCAL_DOMAIN is the instance identity and cannot be changed safely after the first start, so deploy on the final domain.

Registrations are closed by default. Create the owner account in the mastodon container terminal with `tootctl accounts create <username> --email <email> --confirmed --approve --role Owner`; the password is printed in the output. Fill in the SMTP_* variables so other users can confirm their email.

Push notifications stay off until you run `bundle exec rails mastodon:webpush:generate_vapid_key` in the mastodon container terminal, copy the two values into VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY and VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY and redeploy.
